# The stapler in jelly: particles and the springs between them, like an OBJ file.
# Positions are in the stage's units, y up. Particles are counted from 0.
#
#   picture <left> <bottom> <right> <top>   where the pictures sit on the stage
#   p <x> <y> <mass>                        a particle
#   f <x> <y> <mass>                        a particle fixed to the plate
#   s <a> <b> [stiffness]                   a spring between particles a and b; stiffness is its
#                                           share of k' (1 when left out)
#   a <i> <j> <k>                           an angle spring at j, between j-i and j-k
#   t <a> <b> <c>                         a triangle of the picture on three particles

picture -0.6 -0.4 0.6 0.4
